decision.name: INDEPENDENT_CI_COVERAGE_SPLIT
decision.finding: New execution-path reconciliation: public validate.yml supports workflow_dispatch and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests on selected ref, but no pinned two-writer regression file exists on current HEAD; a clean full-suite CI pass would NOT establish equal-T causal snapshot-order correctness. The successful Gemini queue run is on worker-control SHA, not an independent public-HEAD check run. No workflow dispatched due protected workflow boundary. Existing deterministic single anata_latest.json test contract is adequate; do not publish another speculative revision.
decision.source_evidence: runner.run_once loads archive snapshot and independently calls atomic_write_json on latest, audit_latest, anata_latest; atomic visibility test proves whole-file replacement, not causal generation order. Stale overwrite remains plausible, NOT reproduced.
decision.no_new_task_reason: No independently observed red regression and Gemini structured-JSON reliability unverified; pending empty is not sufficient.

execution_blocker.attempted_operation: if test -d /mnt/data/A-Woker-Lab/.git; then git -C /mnt/data/A-Woker-Lab rev-parse HEAD; else printf 'ABSENT_EXACT_REPO:/mnt/data/A-Woker-Lab/.git\n' >&2; exit 42; fi
execution_blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Authorized disposable checkout pinned to public SHA or independent CI with test overlay: execute no-network same-T two-writer single anata_latest.json regression, targeted archive/atomic tests and full Capital Flow pytest; capture source SHA, overlay hash, child exit codes, logs, non-skipped counts; send to C. Existing dispatch-only workflow can at most provide separate full-suite evidence if explicitly authorized and exact run head_sha matches.
